review_notes: I read the whole file. It has three kinds of declaration. The first is projection accessors on the pair-encoded input word, built from the imported machinePairFirst and machinePairSecond. The second is the machine-composition FP-membership lemmas and the `_encode` correctness lemmas. The third is the scanned oracle definition and its validity theorems. The only new data definitions are rawBetheOracleSixteen, rawBetheOracleMargin and scannedBetheBoundedEpigraphOracle. The first two are specific constants and margins in the project's own RawRat type. RawRat, epigraphBase and epigraphHeight are defined in other project files (for example RawRational.lean), not in this file, so this file does not introduce them. The project's Complexity/FP machine model and its encodings are deliberately specific representations. I found no independent Mathlib, Batteries or core declaration that this file duplicates. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for analogues of the imported machine functions, such as machineBinaryListInit versus List.dropLast. Those are defined outside this file, and the machine model needs its own FP-membership proofs. The ofFn_epigraph_center_split lemma is a standalone theorem, which the rubric excludes. I found no case where consolidation would clearly help.
